Blend the almonds in a food processor until most are finely chopped, then pour them into a large bowl. Coarsely chop the figs and then blend them into a smooth, sticky paste. Scrape the almonds and then, with your hands, mix well with the nuts, brandy, honey and cloves.

step 2
Divide the mixture into 6 and form into balls. Place the sesame seeds on a tray and then roll the balls to cover them. Cover the tray loosely with a clean kitchen towel and then let the fig balls dry for a week before packaging them. It will keep in a cool place for 2 months.

db:53164.s:
step 1
Heat the oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Put all the ingredients in a large, wide baking dish. Mix everything with your hands and season.

step 2
Bake for 45 minutes, stirring the onions after 20 minutes, until the chicken is golden brown and the onions are tender. Serve with rice.

db:53165.s:
step 1
In a large, shallow bowl, beat the eggs with the cream, milk, golden caster sugar and sherry. Cut each slice of bread in half and dip them in the egg mixture, turning them to make sure they are well coated on both sides. Soak the bread in the egg mixture for 10 minutes to absorb the liquid (turn them carefully from time to time and make sure they don't get too soggy).

step 2
Heat 1½ tablespoons of olive oil in a large frying pan and cook the bread for about 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy on the edges. Keep the slices warm in the low oven while you cook the rest.

step 3
Divide the torrijas among plates and sprinkle with the icing sugar. Serve with fresh cream or Greek yogurt on the side.

i: 4 tablespoons of Extra Virgin Olive Oil
db:53166.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a large frying pan, then fry the onion for 3-4 minutes until it starts to soften. Add the carrot, celery, thyme and bay leaves. Season and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic, chorizo, cinnamon and smoked paprika. Fry gently until the vegetables soften and the chorizo ​​begins to release its oil and become crispy.

step 2
Add the chickpeas, vinegar and 150ml water, then simmer for 1-2 minutes until the chickpeas have heated through. Add the spinach and then stir in the chickpeas until slightly wilted. Remove from heat, season to taste and serve hot with crusty bread.

db:53167.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and then soften the leek for 5 minutes without browning. Add the chorizo ​​and sauté until it releases its oils. Add the turmeric and rice until coated in the oils, then pour in the broth. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

step 2
Add the peas and cook for 5 minutes, then add the seafood to warm through for a final 1 to 2 minutes or until the rice is cooked. Check seasoning and serve immediately with lemon wedges.

db:53168.s:
step 1
Put a medium saucepan on the heat and pour in the tomatoes, followed by a can of water. While the tomatoes are heating, quickly chop the chorizo ​​coarsely (removing the skin) and shred the cabbage.

step 2
Pile the chorizo and cabbage in the pan with the chili flakes and chickpeas, then crumble them into the stock cube. Stir well, cover and let bubble over high heat for 6 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Serve in bowls and eat with crusty or garlic bread.

db:53169.s:
step 1
Pour the bread into a bowl and pour over 350 ml of water. Let soak for 10 minutes.

step 2
Blend the ingredients together with 350ml of water and 1 teaspoon of salt.

step 3
Let the soup cool in the refrigerator for about 1 hour and then serve with a drizzle of oil and some black pepper.

db:53170.t: Chocolate churros with chocolate & salted caramel sauce
db:53170.s:
step 1
To make the sauce, pour the sugar and butter into a saucepan and simmer until the sugar melts, then add the cream and simmer until you have a smooth sauce, about 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in a pinch of sea salt and the chocolate, and continue stirring for 2-3 minutes, or until completely melted. Keep warm or let cool to reheat later. For the topping, mix the sugar with the cinnamon and a pinch of fine sea salt and set aside.

step 2
For the churros, pour the flour, cocoa, baking powder and a large pinch of salt into a bowl. Add the vanilla extract and melted butter, then carefully pour in 250-300ml boiling water and whisk until you have a smooth, very thick batter. Let cool for a few minutes and then pour the mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a medium star nozzle.

step 3
Pour sunflower oil into a deep fryer following the manufacturer's instructions, or into a heavy-based frying pan, making sure it is no more than a third full. Heat to 170°C, or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Place 12-15cm pieces of dough into the oil, cutting the end of each with scissors as you go. Place four or five at a time and cook for about 4 minutes, or until golden and crisp, turning with tongs or a slotted spoon as they cook. Remove from the oil and place on a wire rack. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Let cool if reheating later; Otherwise, roll the churros in the cinnamon sugar and serve immediately with the warm chocolate sauce and ice cream. To reheat the churros, place them on a tray and bake for 5-8 minutes, then roll in the sugar coating. Meanwhile, heat the sauce in a frying pan and serve as a side.

db:53171.s:
step 1
Heat half the oil in a frying pan and sauté the onion over medium heat until soft and golden; this will take about 8 minutes. Remove from the pan, set aside and add the potatoes to the pan. Cook until tender but not falling apart, carefully turning occasionally. Cover the pan for a little while to help the slices cook through. Place the onions back in the pan along with the garlic and cook for another 4 minutes. Pour into a bowl with the eggs, parsley and a little seasoning and mix. Let it rest for half an hour.

step 2
Meanwhile, put the cod in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a simmer. Remove from heat, cover and let rest for 10 min. Drain, let cool and remove the skin and bones. Break into large flakes and add to the potato and egg mixture.

step 3
Heat the rest of the oil in a non-stick frying pan. Pour in the omelette mixture and cook over medium-low heat until set and pulling away from the sides of the pan. You may need to cover it to help the center set. Be careful not to overcook it. Run a spatula under the tortilla from time to time to make sure it doesn't stick. Slide the tortilla onto a plate, then place the skillet on top and turn the tortilla raw side down. Simmer until golden brown or grill until done. Let cool slightly before serving.

db:53172.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the onion for about 5 minutes until it softens. Add the garlic, chopped tomatoes, tomato puree, paprika, chilli powder, sugar and a pinch of salt and bring to the boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes until pulpy. It can be kept refrigerated for up to 24 hours.

step 2
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Pat the potatoes dry with kitchen paper, then pour them into a roasting tin and add the olive oil and a little seasoning. Roast for 40-50 minutes until crispy and golden. Place the potatoes on serving plates and pour over the tomato sauce. Sprinkle with a little fresh parsley to serve.

db:53173.s:
step 1
In a blender (or with a hand blender), blend the passata, red pepper, chilli, garlic, sherry vinegar and lime juice until smooth. Season to taste and then serve with ice cubes.

db:53174.s:
step 1
Prepare ahead: Cut the pepper in half lengthwise and remove the seeds and stem. Line a frying pan with aluminum foil and place the pepper halves, skin side up, in the pan along with the whole garlic cloves, chilli and tomato. Roast for 2 minutes, turn the tomato over, then roast for 2 more minutes. Remove the tomato with a large spoon, then peel it, cut it into quarters and remove the seeds. Then chop the tomato coarsely.

step 2
Continue roasting the pepper, chilli and garlic for 4-5 minutes, until the skin of the pepper and chilli have blackened and the garlic begins to soften (the skin of the garlic will begin to split when done). When cool enough to handle, peel and cut the chile in half, scrape out and discard the seeds. Peel the pepper and coarsely chop both the pepper and the chilli.

step 3
Spread the nuts on the aluminum foil and grill until toasted. Finely chop the walnuts and parsley in a food processor. Pour into a small bowl.

step 4
Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan, add the pepper, garlic and chilli and fry for 3 minutes. Break up the bread and add it to the pan, stirring in the oil until lightly browned. Pulse in a food processor with the tomatoes, salt, vinegar and oil until coarsely chopped. Pour into a bowl. Let cool and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

step 5
That same day add the walnuts and parsley to the sauce and mix. Serve in a small bowl on a plate with the peeled prawns. Provide cocktail sticks to poke the prawns.

db:53175.s:
step 1
To make the spice mix, combine all ingredients with a large pinch of salt. Cut the lamb shoulder all over with a sharp knife and rub it. If you have time, let it marinate for up to 24 hours, but this is not essential.

step 2
Heat the oven to 150C/130C fan/gas 2. Heat the oil in a large flameproof saucepan or roasting pan over a medium-high heat, add the onions, carrots and garlic and simmer for 5 minutes until the onions and carrots soften. Pour over the broth and then bring to the boil. Place the lamb in the pan and cover, then transfer to the oven and roast for 2 hours.

step 3
Uncover and transfer lamb to a plate with tongs. Stir the beans, peppers and olives into the broth from the pan, return the lamb to the top and return to the oven, uncovered, for 1 hour and 30 minutes until the lamb is cooked through. Transfer the lamb to a board and shred with two forks. Stir the parsley into the stewed beans before serving.

db:53176.t: Spanish tomato bread with jamón Serrano
db:53176.s:
step 1
Mix the chopped tomatoes, garlic clove, olive oil, salt and pepper. Keep in the refrigerator until needed.

step 2
To serve, toast 20 slices of baguette. Place some tomato topping on each toast. Cut 5-6 slices of serrano ham into pieces and put a piece on each slice of bread.

db:53177.s:
step 1
Place a saucepan of water over high heat to bring it to a boil. Meanwhile, cut the chorizo ​​into strips with scissors and chop the parsley and peppers (check for stray seeds first).

step 2
When the water is boiling, add the spaghetti with a good dose of salt, stir and boil again. Cook for 3 minutes.

step 3
In a large frying pan, heat the oil, add the chorizo and peppers and plenty of black pepper. Cook for about a minute, until heated through and the juices are tinged red by the paprika in the chorizo. Scoop out half a cup of pasta water from the pan, drain the rest, and pour the spaghetti into the pan.

step 4
Add the parsley and parmesan, stir well and drizzle with the pasta water to moisten. Serve extra parmesan at the table.

db:53178.s:
step 1
Cut the squid into rings approximately ½ cm thick. Pour the flour into a freezer bag and season well. Add the capers, then shake everything well to combine. Place the squid in the bag and shake again until all the rings are well covered. Mix the garlic and mayonnaise then place in a serving bowl.

step 2
Pour a little oil into a large frying pan until it comes up the sides by about 7cm, but the pan is no more than a third full. Place over medium heat and let the oil heat up. To check that the oil is ready, place a small piece of bread in the pan; It should sizzle when it touches the oil.

step 3
Remove a handful of squid from the flour and shake off the excess. Gently dip into the oil and then cook for about 3 minutes until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on kitchen paper. Repeat with remaining squid. Serve immediately with the mayonnaise and lemon slices.

db:53179.s:
step 1
To make the filling, heat the olive oil in a frying pan until it starts to shimmer. Add the leek and sauté until soft but not coloured. Add the ham with a wooden spoon, fry for 1 minute, then add the flour and fry over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is golden but not burnt; this will take about 5 minutes.

step 2
Meanwhile, combine the broth and milk in a small saucepan and heat until steaming but not boiling. Season with a few gratings of nutmeg. Gradually add the liquid, a few tablespoons at a time, stirring constantly.

step 3
Once you've incorporated all the milk broth, continue cooking the filling over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until it thickens and comes away from the sides of the pan when stirred.

step 4
Season with black pepper, taste and adjust salt if necessary; the ham may be very salty at first. The filling is already made: it has to be very thick because we don't want the croquettes to turn into pancakes.

step 5
Smooth the mixture out onto a baking sheet (30 x 20cm is fine). Once it has stopped smoking, cover with plastic wrap to prevent it from drying out. Let cool before putting in the refrigerator for 1 hour.

step 6
When you're ready for the next stage, line up three bowls: the first filled with flour, the second with beaten egg, and the third with breadcrumbs. Remove the ham mixture from the refrigerator. Put a little olive oil on your hands to make it easier to roll the croquettes.

step 7
Roll a tablespoon of the mixture between your palms. The size and shape of the croquettes is up to you, but the simplest is a ball the size of a walnut. Then start coating as follows.

step 8
Dip the croquettes in flour (if you want to sprinkle them), then in the egg and then in the breadcrumbs. Put them on a tray and, when all the mixture is gone, put them in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

step 9
If you have a deep fryer, heat the oil to 180ºC and fry for a couple of minutes. Otherwise, heat the oil in a deep, heavy-bottomed saucepan until it starts to shimmer. Then add 5-6 croquettes at a time and fry until golden brown all over. Once cooked, drain on kitchen paper and eat immediately.

db:53180.s:
step 1
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan. Pour in the garlic slices and cook for a few seconds. Then stir in the prawns and cook for a couple of minutes until they start to turn pink.

step 2
Pour over the sherry and cook for a few more minutes, until the prawns are cooked through. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

db:53181.s:
step 1
Soak the beans for at least 4 hours or overnight in a large container with plenty of water to cover them. The next day, rinse and drain, then place in a large heavy-based saucepan with the onion, paprika, bunch of herbs and chicken. Pour in enough water or stock to cover, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.

step 2
Remove the chicken to a plate, then add the potatoes and chorizo to the pan. Continue cooking for 30 minutes until the beans and potatoes are tender.

step 3
Discard skin and bones from chicken and cut into large pieces. Return the chicken to the pan with the spinach and simmer for 5 minutes.

db:53182.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a large saucepan and soften the onion for 6-7 minutes. Add the pepper and garlic, cook for 2 more minutes, then add the paella rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring to coat.

step 2
Pour in the broth, add the saffron and bring to a boil. Cook, uncovered, over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender.

step 3
Add the seafood and lemon juice and cook for 2 minutes or until heated through and cooked through. Serve in warm bowls sprinkled with parsley.

db:53183.t: Spanish meatballs with clams, chorizo & squid
db:53183.s:
step 1
Melt the butter in a heavy-based saucepan then soften the shallots for 5 minutes. Add the paprika and crushed garlic and cook for 1 minute until the paprika acquires its aroma. Pour in the sherry and then pour everything into a bowl with the breadcrumbs. Season and cool.

step 2
Add the minced pork and egg yolk to the bowl, then beat well. Form into 18 small meatballs. Wipe out the pan, set it over medium-high heat, and then add the oil. Fry the meatballs for 5 minutes, just to give them color, then place them on a plate, but keeping the oil in the pan. Sauté the chorizo ​​with the sliced ​​garlic. We add the squid and fry so that they give a little color. Now pour in the white wine and bring to a boil, scraping the bottom. Add the pulped tomatoes, bring to a boil and then add the meatballs and clams. Cover and cook for 5 minutes until the clam shells open. Throw away any that remain closed. Sprinkle with chopped parsley, drizzle with extra virgin oil and serve with crusty bread.

db:53184.s:
step 1
Boil the kettle. In a non-stick frying pan or shallow frying pan with a lid, sauté the onion, peppers, chorizo ​​and garlic in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes. Add the rice and chopped tomatoes with 500ml boiling water, cover and cook over high heat for 12 minutes.

step 2
Uncover and then stir; the rice should be almost tender. Add the prawns, with a little more water if the rice looks dry, then cook for another minute until the prawns are pink and the rice is tender.

db:53185.s:
step 1
Put the tomatoes in a bowl with the onion and thyme. Season and then drizzle with vinegar and oil. Let the flavors mix while you cook the chorizo.

step 2
In a hot, dry skillet, fry the chorizo slices until golden brown on both sides. Serve the tomatoes with the fried chorizo, drizzled with a little oil from the pan.

db:53186.t: Chicken with saffron, raisins & pine nuts
db:53186.s:
step 1
Heat a large skillet over high heat and season the chicken. Add the olive oil to the pan, then the chicken. Brown for about 5 minutes on each side, remove to a plate and set aside.

step 2
Lower the heat to medium. In the remaining fat, sauté the onions for 3 minutes, then add the garlic and saffron. Cook for 3-4 more minutes. Add the sherry, then simmer for 3-5 minutes until thick.

step 3
Return the chicken thigh pieces to the pan, add the broth, thyme and raisins, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Add the breast meat and any juice left on the plate. Simmer for 10 more minutes until cooked through and the sauce in the pan has reduced.

step 4
While the chicken is cooking, heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Spread the pine nuts on a baking tray, then roast for 10 minutes until golden and toasted. Once the chicken is cooked through, season to taste, sprinkle with pine nuts and parsley and then serve with rice.

db:53187.s:
1. Prepare the potatoes

Boil the potatoes in their skin until tender.
Let them cool completely (preferably overnight), then peel and chop finely.
2.Make the dough

In a bowl, combine mashed potatoes, flour, semolina and salt.
Knead the mixture until you obtain a soft, non-sticky dough.
3. Shape the spear

Divide the dough into portions and roll each into a thin rope (about 1.5cm in diameter).
Cut into 3cm long pieces and roll them between your palms to form small dough balls.
4. Cook the meatballs

Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.
Place the dough balls in batches and cook until they float to the surface (about 2-3 minutes).
Drain and transfer to a bowl.
5. Prepare the coverage

In a separate bowl, mix the ground poppy seeds and powdered sugar.
Melt the butter and leave it ready.
6. Assemble the plate

Drizzle cooked meatballs with melted butter.
Toss them into the poppy seed and sugar mixture until evenly coated.
7. Serve and enjoy

Serve hot, optionally with a little extra powdered sugar or a drizzle of honey.

db:53188.s:
1. Prepare the bread mixture
Soak the bread slices in milk or water until soft.
Squeeze out excess liquid and blend into small crumbs.
2. Mix the ingredients
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, chopped onion, garlic, soaked bread, egg, and seasonings.
Mix well until evenly combined.
3. Shape meat burgers
Take portions of the mixture and shape them into palm-sized patties.
Flatten slightly to aid even cooking.
4. Cover the burgers
Lightly dust each burger with flour.
Dip them in beaten egg and then coat them in breadcrumbs for a crispy finish.
5. Fry the Fašírky
Heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the burgers for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
6. Serve and enjoy
Serve Fašírky hot with mashed potatoes, coleslaw or fresh bread.
Enjoy with mustard, pickles, or garlic sauce for added flavor.

db:53189.s:
1. Prepare the potatoes
We start by peeling and finely grating the potatoes. To ensure extra crispiness, use a clean kitchen towel to squeeze out as much moisture as possible.

2. Mix the ingredients
In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, eggs, flour, marjoram, salt, and black pepper. Stir well until the mixture forms a thick, consistent dough.

3. Heat the oil
In a large skillet, heat a generous amount of oil over medium heat. The oil should be hot but not smoking.

4. Fry the Pancakes
Pour portions of the batter into the pan, flattening each into a thin pancake. Fry until golden and crispy on one side, then flip and cook the other side until equally golden and crispy.

5. Drain and serve
Transfer cooked pancakes to a plate lined with paper towels to remove excess oil. Serve immediately while hot, with sour cream, garlic sauce, or as a garnish.

db:53190.s:
1. Prepare the dough
Grate the potatoes finely with a hand grater or a food processor. Place the grated potatoes in a bowl and mix them with flour, egg and salt until a sticky dough forms. The consistency should be thick but flexible.

2. Cook the meatballs
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Using a halušky maker (similar to a spaetzle maker), press the dough directly into the boiling water. If you don't have one, use a slanted cutting board and knife to scrape small pieces of dough into the water.

Let the dough balls cook until they float to the surface, usually 2 to 3 minutes. Remove them with a slotted spoon and set them aside in a large bowl.

3. Prepare the ingredients
Chop the bacon into small pieces and fry in a frying pan over medium heat until crispy. If using a bryndza substitute, mix crumbled feta cheese with a tablespoon of sour cream to mimic the tangy flavor of traditional Slovak pecorino.

4. Assemble the plate
Toss the cooked meatballs with the bryndza cheese (or substitute) until well coated and creamy. Top with the crispy bacon and its drippings. Garnish with chopped chives or parsley for an extra touch of color and flavor.

db:53191.s:
step 1
Place the noodles in a large heatproof bowl, pour boiling water over them and leave for 4 minutes, then drain and refresh under cold running water.

step 2
Put the lime juice, cayenne, sugar and fish sauce in a bowl and mix well. Have all other ingredients ready next to the pot.

step 3
Heat the oil and fry the prawns until they are hot. Add the scallions and noodles and stir. Pour in the lemon juice mixture, then add the bean sprouts, half the peanuts, and cilantro. Cook for 1 minute until everything is heated through.

step 4
Pile on a large plate, sprinkle with the rest of the peanuts and cilantro and serve with lime wedges and sweet chili sauce.

db:53192.s:
step 1
First, make the curry paste. Use a mortar and pestle to pound the dried and fresh chiles, shrimp paste, garlic, galangal, lemongrass, lime zest, white pepper, coriander, cumin, nutmeg, and peanuts, plus 1 teaspoon salt. You should have a rough paste. Alternatively, add all ingredients to a food processor along with 2-3 tablespoons of coconut milk and pulse until you have a paste. Store in a jar with a lid in the refrigerator. It will keep for up to two weeks.

step 2
Add 2-3 tablespoons of the thick part of the coconut milk to a saucepan over medium-high heat. When the coconut milk starts to bubble, add 1-2 tablespoons of curry paste and stir well for about 1 minute, until fragrant.

step 3
Add the chicken and let it cook for about 3-4 minutes until it starts to brown all over. Continue with the green beans and stir well.

step 4
Season with the fish sauce and sugar, then add the rest of the coconut milk. Mix well, add half the makrut lime leaves and simmer for 3-5 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Taste and add more sugar or fish sauce if necessary; It should be salty and nutty, and the sweetness should be noticeable. Add the Thai basil leaves, mix quickly and remove from heat. Serve with steamed jasmine rice, garnished with the sliced ​​chili and the rest of the makrut lime leaves.

db:53193.s:
step 1
Prepare the noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside. Combine all the ingredients for the sauce in a small bowl or jug ​​and set aside.

step 2
Heat the oil in a large wok or frying pan over high heat and sauté the garlic and chilli for 20 seconds until they start to brown. Add the steak and sauté for 1 minute until browned and beginning to brown. Add the broccoli and sauté for another minute, then pour in the noodles and add the sauce. Stir-fry for a further 1-2 minutes until well combined and heated through.

step 3
Stir in the basil and turn off the heat. Serve immediately to prevent overcooking.

db:53194.s:
step 1
Pour 1.3 liters of water into a large saucepan over high heat. Add the onion, tomato, chilli, galangal, lemongrass, prawn heads and chicken stock cube. Stir and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 20 minutes until the liquid is reduced.

step 2
Carefully strain the hot broth into a large heatproof bowl or jug, then discard the shrimp heads. Return the strained vegetable and herb mixture to the saucepan and pour over the broth. Add the mushrooms and lime leaves, then cook for 3 minutes until the mushrooms are tender.

step 3
Add 1 tablespoon of sugar, the fish sauce, lime juice, coconut milk and shrimp. Bring to the boil and cook until the prawns are cooked through, about 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove the lemongrass and then add the Thai chili jam, if using. Sprinkle cilantro to finish, if you like, and serve.

db:53195.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the curry paste for 1 minute before adding the sautéed vegetables and prawns. Cook for 3 minutes until the prawns are almost pink, then add the coconut milk, vegetable broth and noodles.

step 2
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes until the noodles are cooked through and the vegetables are tender but still have a bite. Divide between two bowls and sprinkle over the herbs, chilli and spring onion.

db:53196.t: Tom yum (hot & sour) soup with prawns
db:53196.s:
step 1
Bring the broth to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add the lemongrass, galangal, coriander roots and lime leaves, then simmer for 2 minutes.

step 2
Add the prawns, fish sauce, chillies and lime juice, then return to a boil. Taste and adjust the seasoning with more lemon juice or fish sauce, then garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

db:53197.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a large saucepan or flameproof casserole. Add the scallions and cilantro stems and cook for 1 min. Add the pork slices and cook for 5 minutes until starting to brown.

step 2
Add curry paste and peanut butter. After 30 seconds, add the sugar, soy and coconut milk, plus ½ can of water. Mix well, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

step 3
Remove the lid, add the sweet corn and increase the heat. Bubble for 3 minutes until the corn is cooked and the sauce has thickened slightly. Add the lime juice and check the seasoning. It can now be frozen for up to 2 months. To cook from frozen: Thaw completely, then heat in a pan on the hob until the curry is heated through. Serve sprinkled with cilantro leaves and rice.

db:53198.t: Thai fried rice with prawns & peas
db:53198.s:
step 1
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok, add the onion, garlic and chilli and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden. Add the prawns and cook for 1 min. Add the rice and peas and continue stirring until very hot. Add the soy and fish sauce, then stir in the chopped cilantro. Keep warm while frying the eggs.

step 2
Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan and fry the eggs with a little seasoning. Divide the fried rice mixture among 4 bowls and top each with a fried egg. Serve sprinkled with cilantro, with chili sauce, if desired.

db:53199.s:
step 1
Heat a wok or large skillet until smoking. Pour in the oil and stir the pan, then add the beef strips and chili. Cook, stirring all the time, until the meat is lightly browned, about 3 minutes, then pour over the oyster sauce. Cook until heated through and sauce coats meat. add basil leaves and serve with plain rice.

db:53200.s:
step 1
Put the shrimp in a bowl. Place the chili, garlic, coriander stems (cut them first with scissors) and powdered sugar in a spice grinder or small food processor and blend. Add half the lime juice and fish sauce, then pour over the shrimp.

step 2
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok, add ginger and scallions and stir-fry for 1 min. Add the red pepper and sauté for 1 min, until the pepper begins to soften. Add the water chestnuts and bean sprouts and mix until the bean sprouts begin to wilt. Add the soy sauce and a very good crack of black pepper, then pour everything onto a serving platter.

step 3
Heat the remaining oil in the wok and add the prawns, removing their juice. Mix for 1-2 minutes until they turn pink, add the marinade and give the wok a quick shake, then pour it all over the vegetables. Cut the cilantro leaves and sprinkle with the remaining lime. Serve over noodles with extra lime for squeezing.

db:53201.s:
Heat a wok or large frying pan until very hot, then add 1 tablespoon oil. When it is very hot, add the chicken and fry over high heat for 8-10 minutes, until completely browned. Using a slotted spoon, remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.

step 2
Reheat the wok and add the remaining oil. Add the garlic and shallots and sauté for 3 minutes, until golden.

step 3
Return the chicken to the wok and add the chiles, fish sauce, dark soy sauce, and sugar. Sauté over high heat for a further 8-10 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Add the basil leaves and serve immediately.

i: 1 small clove of garlic finely chopped
db:53202.s:
step 1
Place the fish fillets side by side on a large square of foil and scatter the ginger, garlic, chilli and lime zest over them. Drizzle the lemon juice on top and then scatter the pak choi pieces around and on top of the fish. Pour the soy sauce over the pak choi and loosely seal the foil to form a packet, making sure to leave room at the top for steam to circulate as the fish cooks.

step 2
Steam for 15 minutes. (If you don't have a steamer, place the packet on a heatproof plate over a saucepan of simmering water, cover with a lid, and steam.)

db:53203.s:
step 1
Place the noodles and bean sprouts in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for 4 minutes or until the noodles are tender. Drain, then cool under cold running water and drain again. Return to the bowl.

step 2
Mix lime zest and juice, fish or soy sauce, and sugar. Add the noodles with the red onion and lettuce.

step 3
To make with minced meat, heat a little oil in a non-stick frying pan and sauté 500g minced pork, a small portion of grated ginger and a pinch of cayenne pepper or chilli powder for 10 minutes, until the minced meat is golden brown and cooked through. Toss with noodles, divide among four bowls, and serve hot.

step 4
To prepare the steak, prepare the rice noodle salad. Heat 1 teaspoon of sunflower oil in a frying pan. Pour 2 tablespoons of sesame seeds on a plate. Rub 1 teaspoon oil on 4 175g sirloin steaks and press into the sesame seeds. Fry for 5 minutes over medium heat, turning halfway through. Let it sit for 5 minutes and then cut into thin slices. Mix 1 seeded and grated red chili and a handful of mint leaves into the noodles. Top with steak to serve.

i: 1 red onion cut into thin wedges
db:53204.s:
step 1
Light the barbecue or heat a griddle over high heat. Pour the chicken, curry paste, and coconut milk into a bowl, then mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. Thread vegetables and chicken onto skewers. Cook the skewers on the barbecue or griddle for 5 to 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and charred. Serve with herbed rice, salad and half a lime for squeezing.

db:53205.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a medium saucepan. Add the onion and ginger, then cook for a few minutes until softened. Add the curry paste and cook for 1 more minute. Pour over the chopped tomatoes and coconut cream. Bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes, adding a little boiling water if the mixture thickens too much.

step 2
Pour in the shrimp and cook for another 5 to 10 minutes, depending on their size. Serve alongside some plain rice and sprinkle with some chopped cilantro, if desired.

db:53206.t: Thai chicken cakes with sweet chilli sauce
db:53206.s:
step 1
Blend the chicken, garlic, ginger, onion, cilantro and chili in a food processor and season well. Blend until the chicken is finely ground and everything is well mixed. Use your hands to shape six small cakes.

step 2
Heat the oil in a frying pan, then fry the cakes over medium heat for about 6-8 minutes, turning once. Serve hot, with sweet chili sauce, lime wedges, cilantro, grated scallion and red chili.

db:53207.s:
step 1
Pour the chicken broth and coconut milk into a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves and cook over low heat, about 6 to 8 minutes. Maintaining a simmer, add the chicken. Cook for 8-10 minutes until tender and cooked through.

step 2
Add the mushrooms and chillies and simmer for a further 3 to 5 minutes until everything is cooked through. Sprinkle with sugar and 3 tablespoons each of fish sauce and lime juice. Taste and add the rest if necessary.

step 3
Remove the galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves before serving with a slotted spoon. Ladle into bowls and serve with sprinkled coriander leaves and steamed rice on the side. It will stay cold for up to three days. Let cool first.

i: 1 ½ tablespoons Thai red curry paste
db:53208.s:
step 1
Place the curry paste in a large saucepan or wok with the oil. Fry for 1 min until fragrant. Add the vegetable broth, coconut milk and brown sugar. Simmer for 3 minutes.

step 2
Add the noodles, carrots and bok choy leaves and simmer for 4-6 minutes, until all are tender. Add the bean sprouts and tomatoes. Add lemon juice to taste and a little extra seasoning, if desired. Pour into bowls and sprinkle with scallions and cilantro.

db:53209.s:
step 1
Cook the noodles according to package directions, drain, and set aside for later. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and pour in the beaten egg. Turn the pan to make a thin omelette, cook for 1-2 minutes, then flip and cook the other side for 1 minute. Take out and cut into thin strips.

step 2
Add the chilli and ginger to the pan, fry for 1-2 minutes and then add the noodles, prawns and egg. Add the soy sauce and sauté for 1 more minute. Toss in the chopped herbs and pour over the juice and lime zest, then sprinkle over the chopped peanuts and serve.

db:53210.s:
step 1
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the pumpkin in a roasting dish with half the oil and seasoning, then roast for 30 minutes until golden and tender.

step 2
Meanwhile, put the remaining oil in a frying pan with the onion, ginger and lemongrass. Cook gently for 8 to 10 minutes until softened. Add the curry paste for 1 minute, followed by the roasted pumpkin, all but 3 tablespoons of the coconut milk, and the broth. Bring to a simmer, cook for 5 minutes and then remove the lemongrass. Let cool for a few minutes, then beat until smooth with a hand mixer or in a large blender in batches. Return to skillet to heat, seasoning with salt, pepper, lemon juice, and sugar, if necessary. Serve drizzled with the rest of the coconut milk and sprinkled with chili, if desired.

db:53211.s:
step 1
Place the ginger, garlic, lemongrass, coriander and 1 chilli in a food processor, then pulse until puree. Heat the oil in a frying pan over low heat. Add the puree and cook for 5 minutes. Add the meat, soy, five spices, sugar and broth. Cover and bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove the lid and cook for 15 more minutes until the meat is tender.

step 2
Just before serving, prepare the noodles following package directions. Drain well, then divide between 2 bowls and pour over the beef stew. Serve sprinkled with the rest of the chilli and coriander leaves, with lime wedges for squeezing.

db:53212.s:
step 1
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and line a baking tray with aluminum foil. Mix the chili sauce with the orange zest and juice, garlic, curry paste and ¼ teaspoon salt. Add the chicken and cover very well.

step 2
Place the drumsticks on the aluminum foil, spaced apart. Cover the chicken with any marinade left in the bowl and then roast for 35 to 40 minutes until tender. Wrap it in aluminum foil or wrap it in a food container.

db:53213.s:
step 1
Cook noodles following package instructions. Refresh in cold water and drain well.

step 2
Put the stock into a large saucepan and add the curry paste, lime leaves, fish sauce and 250ml cold water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.

step 3
Cut the fish into cubes of about 3 cm and add them to the pan. Return to a simmer and then cook for 2 minutes uncovered.

step 4
Add the noodles, prawns and pak choi and simmer for 2-3 minutes or until the fish and prawns are just cooked. Serve in bowls sprinkled with cilantro.

db:53214.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in your largest frying pan, add the onion and fry for 3 minutes to soften. Add the chicken and garlic and cook until the chicken changes color.

step 2
Add the curry paste, coconut milk, stock, lime leaves and fish sauce, then simmer for 12 minutes. Add the chopped onion tips, green beans and bamboo shoots and cook for 4-6 minutes, until the beans are tender.

step 3
Meanwhile, put the lime juice and basil in a narrow jug and blend with a hand blender until you have a smooth green paste. Pour into the soup with the sliced ​​spring onion and heat. Serve with lime wedges for a light lunch or dinner or as a make-ahead starter.

db:53215.s:
1
First, sauté the black pepper and garlic over medium dry heat until fragrant.
2
Add a good amount of extra virgin olive oil and let it infuse for a minute.
3
Once the oil is hot, add the tomatoes and salt and cover with a lid. Simmer for 5 minutes.
4
Remove the lid and mash the tomatoes. Reduce until desired consistency of choice is reached.
5
Make craters for the eggs and lower the heat. Carefully crack the eggs into the craters, making sure they touch the pan and not the tomato sauce.
6
Cover the eggs and let them rest for 5 minutes without lifting the lid.
7
Remove from heat and let the residual heat steam the eggs for 1-2 minutes.
8
Serve with flatbread. Enjoy!

db:53216.s:
1
Take the kanfhe in a bowl and cut them into large pieces. Pour in the melted butter, yellow food coloring and mix well with your hands.
In a separate container, mix the milk, cream cheese, sugar and cornstarch well.
2
Turn on the heat and boil the liquid, when it thickens, turn off the heat and let it cool a little.
Add mozzarella and mix well.
Now make a base with half of the kanfhe on a plate, press gently to level the dough well.
Pour the cheese mixture on top and level with a spoon.
3
Cover it with the other half of the kanfhe.
Place the dish in an oven preheated to 200 degrees for about 20-25 minutes.
It will be ready when the kunafa is golden brown and crispy on the surface.
4
Boil water in a saucepan and dissolve the sugar for 4 to 5 minutes. Or cook it until it thickens slightly and keep stirring. Add the lemon juice to the rose water, mix well.
Evenly pour the syrup over the kunafa as soon as it comes out of the oven.
Your kunafa is ready to serve.

db:53217.s:
1
In a slow cooker or slow cooker, add all the spices, beef broth, and lemon juice. Stir to combine.
2
Add the meat and turn to coat, pour a little sauce over the top.
3
Cover and simmer for 8 to 10 hours.
4
After cooking, remove the meat and use two forks to shred. Discard excess fat.
5
Skim the fat from the top of the remaining liquid.
6
Mix the shredded meat with the sauce. Keep warm until ready to serve.
7
Prepare a wrap by spreading garlic sauce on the pita bread. Top with meat and add garnishes as desired.
8
Fold it burrito style.
9
Heat a frying pan and grill the wrap.

db:53218.t: Chicken Shawarma with homemade garlic herb yoghurt sauce
db:53218.s:
1
Start by cutting the chicken into reasonably small slices. Take your ziplock bag and throw the freshly cut chicken inside.
2
Add garlic, coriander, cumin, cardamom, cayenne pepper, paprika, salt, pepper, lemon juice and olive oil to the bag. Close the bag and mix well. Place in the refrigerator for 10 to 12 hours (the shorter is fine, but the longer the better).
3
Once ready to cook, heat the pan over medium-high heat and add a little bit of olive oil. Fry one side of all the flatbreads until lightly toasted. Remove from pan, add enough oil to cover pan. Place the crumbled fries in the air fryer at 180 for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4
The pan should be quite hot by now, add the chicken in 2 batches (unless you have a large pan) to avoid overcrowding. The chicken should be nicely browned and darker in color, which is perfect. Cook for a further 5-8 minutes or until cooked through. Repeat with next batch of chicken.
5
While the chicken is cooking, place the Greek yogurt in a bowl. Combine garlic, finely chopped mint and parsley, squeeze in about lemon and cumin. Combine and add salt to taste. In a small bowl, combine 1 teaspoon garlic powder, paprika, cumin, onion powder, oregano, dried parsley, cayenne pepper (optional) and set aside for the fries.
6
Season the fries immediately once cooked and add salt to taste. Once the chicken is ready, serve immediately by placing the flatbread, spreading the sauce evenly over the bread, add lettuce, onion, tomato, fries, chicken, feta cheese and more sauce on top. Serve immediately.

db:53219.s:
1
In a frying pan, heat the oil over medium to high heat, with a tablespoon of olive oil.
2
Add chopped vegetables such as onion, garlic, celery and red pepper. Stir everything together for 5 minutes.
3
Add the cumin powder, salt, pepper and tomato sauce and cook for another 7 minutes.
4
Add the eggs, cover and let cook for 8 min. Add the fresh spinach and feta cheese at the end.
5
Serve with fresh bread.

db:53220.s:
1
Caramelize the chicken with olive oil, then add a maggi cube and boil for about 30 minutes.
2
In another pot add all the vegetables and caramelize them until they are soft.
3
Once everything is ready, add the rice, raisins and spices to the vegetables and add 2 and a half cups of water to cook the rice.
4
Once the rice is done, put everything in the oven.

db:53221.s:
1
Mix the butter with the sugar until creamy.
2
Add oil flour and semolina and mix.
3
Add the warm milk and do not knead too much.
4
Cover and let sit for an hour or less until the filling is prepared.
5
For the date filling, fry some sesame in a pan and then add butter. Add the date paste and mix well with the sesame and butter. Then add a little water until soft. Be careful not to make it too soft.
6
Remove it from the pan, put it on a plate until it cools. Then start forming balls that weigh 15 g.
7
Refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
8
Return to the dough and shape it into balls weighing 30 g.
9
Take the date filling out of the refrigerator and start filling each dough ball with date ball.
Then use the mamoul mold to give it this shape.
10
In a preheated oven at 180 degrees, put it in for 20 minutes until it is golden brown on the bottom and a little on top.

db:53222.s:
1
Fry the onion and pepper together over medium heat until the onion is soft.
2
Add the garlic granules and cook for a minute.
3
Add chopped tomatoes and remaining spices, stir well
4
Simmer for about 20 minutes.
5
Make wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
6
Once the whites are cooked through, decorate and serve with toast.

db:53223.s:
1
Heat the pan and add a little oil. Fry the mashed garlic and ginger first and then add in the minced meat and all seasoning. When the meat is cooked, let it cool.
2
Get another large bowl. Add the egg, chopped tomato, chopped spring onion and minced meat.
3
Get 2 sheets of phyllo dough or 1 sheet of spring roll wrapper. Spread with a little butter and then put some filling in the middle. Fold the dough and spread more butter on the seal part.
4
Heat a frying pan and add a little oil to cook the packet until both sides and all 4 edges are golden brown. (Or spread melted butter all over the package and bake in the oven at 180°C for 10-15 minutes)
Enjoy.

db:53224.t: Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate Cake and Cupcakes
db:53224.s:
1
For the Chocolate Cake: Ready all the ingredients. Sprinkle oreo cookies, pinch of salt and mix warm milk as needed and make a cake batter. Add the baking powder and vinegar and mix.
2
Grease a loose-bottomed tin. Pour a layer of dough 1 cm thick.
3
Bake in a preheated oven at 160°C for 7-8 minutes or until a knife inserted into it comes out clean. Let cool on a rack.
4
For the homemade pistachio paste: Prepare all the ingredients for the pistachio paste. Lightly melt the white chocolate in a double boiler (otherwise the mixer paddle may break). Sprinkle coarsely chopped pistachio into blender. Add the condensed milk.
5
Add slightly warmed and slightly melted white and milk chocolate as needed and blend to a smooth paste (green food coloring can be added. I haven't done this).
6
For Kunafa: In a kadhaai, take ghee and roast the sevaiiya on low heat. Keep stirring until a nice toasted aroma is released. Let it cool. Add the homemade pistachio paste and mix well.
7
Lip-smacking Kunafa is ready. Spread a 2cm layer on the cooled chocolate cake.
8
Melt the dark chocolate and strained malai and prepare the chocolate ganache. Cool and pour over the Kunafa layer.
9
Garnish Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate Cake with chopped pistachio and silver balls. Store in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours. Then unmold the Kunafa Cake.
10
I also made Kunafa pastries. Cut and enjoy. The cake looked so pretty we could keep it or keep it!! ☺
11
Cross-sectional view of Kunafa Pistachio Chocolate Cake.
12
Enjoy a new sweet treat this holiday season with family and friends.

db:53225.s:
1
First, over medium heat, heat the olive oil and add the chopped onion until it turns golden. Then, add the tomatoes and cook for another 4-5 min. Lastly, add all the spices, salt and ground pepper.
2
Add the eggs and mix well for 2 minutes and cover to cook for 5 to 6 minutes until the surface is solid. Finally, spread the liquid cheese and leave it covered for a minute.
3
I served mine Mediterranean style with French fries, Egyptian fava beans, salami and Turkish olives, cheese slices and Greek feta.

db:53226.s:
1
Sift the flour and add the baking powder, salt, sugar, oil and mix.
2
Add water and knead the dough for about 10 minutes.
3
Cover the mixture and let it rise.
4
After it has risen, transfer it to a work surface and shape it into a round (you can use a plate or a pot lid)
5
Heat your pan and put it on.
6
It will start blowing and then you turn it.
7
And finally put it in a warm place, then you will see that it has a pocket.

db:53227.s:
step 1
Place the cabbage in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Season with ½ teaspoon salt, stir well and set aside for 15 minutes. Pour onto a clean tea towel and squeeze out as much water as you can. Pour into a bowl with the carrot, mushrooms, minced pork, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and scallions. Season with black pepper. Mash everything with your hands, mixing well until everything is combined.

step 2
Soak the spring roll sheets for a couple of seconds in a shallow dish of warm water and then transfer them to a greased cutting board. Working with one sheet at a time, pour 1 heaping tablespoon of the filling into the middle, then fold the bottom up and over the filling. Fold down the top of the leaf, then the sides to cover it completely and form a neat square. If the dough ball feels a little fragile, soak another sheet and wrap it again. Repeat with remaining sheets and filling, transferring meatballs to a greased plate as you go.

step 3
Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan (making sure it is no more than a third full) over medium-high heat and fry the dumplings for 3-5 minutes until golden brown. Use a slotted spoon or spider to turn them over, then cover with a lid and cook for another 3-4 minutes until golden brown. Remove the lid and cook for 1-2 minutes.

step 4
Meanwhile, combine all sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Serve the meatballs with the dipping sauce on the side.

db:53228.s:
step 1
Put the sugar in a large, shallow saucepan, along with a splash of water. Heat gently, moving the pan, until the sugar has dissolved. Increase the heat and bubble the syrup until it turns a dark amber color. Add the fish sauce, most of the chilli and ginger, then add 1 tablespoon water to thin. Boil again until thick, then add the fish fillets, skin side down, and the bok choi, cut side down.

step 2
Cover the pan with a lid and simmer for 4-5 minutes until the fish is cooked and the bok choi has wilted. Turn off the heat, squeeze over the lemon and sprinkle with the rest of the chilli, ginger and coriander sprigs. Serve with rice.

db:53229.s:
step 1
Mix all the dressing ingredients in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of water until the sugar has dissolved.

step 2
Cook the noodles according to package directions, then submerge them in a bowl of cold water to cool completely. Drain the noodles, then add the carrot, cabbage, scallion and dressing, and toss to combine.

step 3
Heat the oil in a frying pan over high heat. Season the steak and then cook it to your liking; 2-3 minutes on each side over medium heat. Let rest for 5 minutes and then cut into slices. Divide the salad and steak slices among bowls and scatter with a little cilantro to serve.

db:53230.t: Purple sprouting broccoli tempura with nuoc cham
db:53230.s:
step 1
For the nuoc cham, mix all ingredients with 5 tablespoons of hot water in a small bowl. Set aside while you make the tempura.

step 2
Whisk together the cornmeal, all-purpose flour, sesame seeds (if using), and a large pinch of salt. Fill a large, deep frying pan, no more than a third full, with vegetable oil and heat it until it reaches 180°C or a cube of bread browns in 20 seconds.

step 3
Quickly stir the soda water into the flour mixture, being careful not to overmix, then dip the broccoli in with tongs. Carefully dip into the hot oil and cook for 2-3 minutes until crisp. Drain on kitchen paper and then serve with the nuoc cham on the side for dipping.

db:53231.t: Vietnamese lamb shanks with sweet potatoes
i: 3 cloves of garlic cut into thin slices
db:53231.s:
step 1
Heat the oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy-bottomed saucepan, season the legs, then brown them 2 at a time on all sides, adding the remaining oil for the second batch. Remove the lamb and add the onions. Fry them quite quickly, about 30 seconds, add the ginger, garlic and chopped chilli, then lower the heat and cook for 1 minute. Add 1 tablespoon sugar, stir, then add star anise, lemongrass, stock, puree and seasonings. Bring to a boil.

step 2
Cover and cook in the oven for 1½ hours, then add the sweet potatoes and cook for 1 more hour. The lamb should be completely tender and almost falling off the bones. Add the fish sauce, lemon juice and 1 teaspoon sugar to enhance the flavour, then sprinkle with the mint, basil and sliced ​​chilli to serve.

db:53232.s:
step 1
To make the dressing, mix all ingredients in a large serving bowl. Cook the noodles according to package directions, then drain and add to the bowl with the dressing.

step 2
Peel the carrot into long strips with a vegetable peeler. Do the same with the cucumber, until you reach the seeds (discard them). Add the carrot and cucumber to the noodle mixture along with the shredded chicken, radishes, red onion, and mint. Toss well to coat with dressing, scatter over peanuts and serve.

db:53233.s:
step 1
To make the sauce, mix all the ingredients in a small bowl until the sugar dissolves, then set aside. Mix the cornmeal and all-purpose flour with both peppers and 2 teaspoons sea salt in a large bowl, then set aside. Line a tray with kitchen paper and make sure you have more salt to sprinkle.

step 2
Heat about 7 cm of oil to 180 ° C in a deep fryer, wok or frying pan. If you don't have a thermometer, you can test it with a cube of bread; It should brown in 20 seconds. Coat the squid well with the flour mixture and fry in batches for about 2 minutes each or until crispy. Use a slotted spoon to remove the squid, then drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle with a little more salt. Serve the squid sprinkled with the spring onion and chilli, with the dipping sauce on the side.

db:53234.s:
step 1
Pour the broth into a large saucepan, bring to a boil, then add the curry paste. Add the noodles and cook for 8 minutes. Add mushrooms and corn and cook for 2 more minutes.

step 2
Add the salmon to the pan and cook for 3 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from the heat and add the lime juice, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar. Serve in 4 bowls and sprinkle over the cilantro just before serving.

db:53235.s:
step 1
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork in batches until browned all over. Remove with a slotted spoon and reserve.

step 2
Lower the heat and add the remaining oil, then add the shallots, ginger and chilli. Simmer for a couple of minutes until it starts to soften. Add the sugar, fish sauce and 200 ml of water to the saucepan and stir everything together. Bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve the sugar, then return the pork to the pan. Bubble vigorously for 8 to 10 minutes until the sauce thickens to coat the meat and becomes glossy. Taste and add a little more fish sauce, if necessary, along with the chili sauce. Sprinkle with the scallions and serve with steamed rice and pak choi.

db:53236.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a medium-sized saucepan with a lid. Add the ginger and garlic and sauté for about 5 minutes. Add the pumpkin, soy sauce, sugar and broth. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove the lid, add the green beans and cook for 3 more minutes until the squash and beans are tender. Stir in the scallions at the last minute, then sprinkle with cilantro and serve with rice.

db:53237.s:
step 1
The day before: make the dressing. Put the sugar and lime juice in a saucepan with 1 tablespoon of water and bring to the boil to dissolve the sugar. Add the chilli and coriander and stir well, then puree in a blender until smooth. Pour into a bowl, then add sesame oil, fish sauce, soy sauce and sesame seeds to make a dressing. Cover and chill until needed.

step 2
Two hours before serving: heat a griddle. Preheat the oven to 200C/gas 6/fan 180C. Brush the pork with oil and grill on all sides for a few minutes until browned. Transfer to a baking tray and place in the oven for about 10-12 minutes until cooked through. Let cool and cut into thin slices against the grain of the meat. Pour into a bowl and pour over half the dressing.

step 3
To serve: Toss remaining salad ingredients in a bowl with remaining dressing. Place them on a platter, cover with the pork slices and pour over the juice.

db:53238.s:
step 1
Pour the beef stock along with 500ml water into a large saucepan. Place the onion and ginger in a skillet over high heat and cook on all sides, about 3 to 5 minutes (you can also do this under the broiler). Once charred, add it to the beef broth. In the same pan, toast the spices for 2-3 minutes and once they start to smell fragrant, add them to the meat broth as well. Bring the broth to the boil, then bring to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes before straining.

step 2
Meanwhile, trim the fat from the steak and wrap it in plastic wrap, then put it in the freezer for 15 minutes. This will make the steak really easy to cut! Cut it into thin slices, cover it again with plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator.

step 3
Try beef broth and use palm sugar, fish sauce and soy for seasoning. Cook the noodles according to package directions and divide between two bowls, topping each with the sliced ​​meat. Bring the broth to a boil and then pour it into the bowls (the heat will cook the meat). Top each with the scallions, chili slices and herbs. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing.

db:53239.s:
step 1
Cook the noodles according to package directions, then rinse them under cold water and drain well. In a small saucepan, melt the peanut butter, coconut milk, sweet chili sauce, and half the scallions, adding 1-2 tablespoons water to loosen the mixture to a drizzling consistency.

step 2
Toss noodles, cucumber and bean sprouts on a serving platter. Top with the shrimp, drizzle with the peanut sauce, and scatter over the remaining scallions.

db:53240.s:
step 1
Heat the oil in a non-stick wok. Add the broccoli, then fry over high heat for 5 minutes or until tender, adding a little water if it starts to catch fire. Add the garlic and chilli, fry for 1 minute, then add the scallions, soya beans, pak choi and tofu. Sauté for 2-3 minutes. Add the hoisin, soybeans and walnuts to heat.

db:53241.s:
step 1
Soak rice flour pancakes according to package directions or in boiling water for 30 seconds. Remove and cool on kitchen paper. Soak the rice noodles according to package instructions, then drain and cut into 2cm strips.

step 2
Place a rice cake on a board and place some rice noodles, chicken, vegetables and herb leaves about a third of the way up, leaving a 1cm border on one side. Fold the sides over the vegetables and then roll lengthwise to make a cigar. Store in the refrigerator, covered with damp kitchen paper, for up to 1 day.

step 3
Mix the ingredients for the sauce and put them in a bowl. To serve, place the rolls on a plate along with the leaves and herbs. To eat, wrap each roll in a piece of lettuce with a sprig of herbs and dip in the sauce.

db:53242.s:
step 1
Heat the oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas. Mix sugar with bread mix in a large bowl, then add water as directed on package. Bring the dough together with a wooden spoon, then knead on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth. Place in a large bowl, cover with greased plastic wrap and leave in a warm place until doubled in size.

step 2
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and then fry the bacon until crispy, about 5 minutes. Add the ginger and garlic and sauté for 1 minute until tender, then add the soy, honey and tomato puree and stir well. It can be done up to 3 days in advance.

step 3
Scoop out the dough and knead briefly, then form into 12 equal-sized balls. Flatten with your hands and then place a teaspoon-sized blob of filling in the middle. Lift the dough and close it like a bag, then turn the bun inside out and place it on a large baking sheet. Cover with greased plastic wrap and let rest for about 30 minutes until the dough feels spongy. Brush with egg and bake for 20 minutes until golden. Serve hot with dipping sauce. It can be frozen after the second rise for up to 1 month or baked up to a day ahead and reheated.

db:53243.s:
step 1
Mix all the ingredients for the sauce together with 50ml water in a bowl and set aside to allow the sugar to dissolve and the flavor to infuse.

step 2
To assemble the buns, fill a wide bowl with warm water and take a clean, damp kitchen towel to work with. Dip a rice paper wrapper in the water for a few seconds until it softens, then carefully place it on the kitchen towel.

step 3
Place some mint and coriander leaves in the center of the wrapper and then top with two prawns and a small handful of spiralized vegetables, which may need to be cut if the spirals are too long.

step 4
Fold the sides of the wrapper toward the center, over the filling, then fold the edges so that the filling is completely covered, then roll tightly. Repeat until all wrappers and filling have been used. To serve, cut diagonally and eat with the dipping sauce.

db:53244.t: Prawn & noodle salad with crispy shallots
db:53244.s:
step 1
For the crispy shallots, heat 5cm of oil until hot in a wok. You'll know the oil is hot enough when a piece of shallot sizzles as soon as you drop it. Toss the shallot slices with flour, shake off the excess, and fry in the oil until golden brown. They fry quickly, about 1 min. Drain on kitchen paper, sprinkle with salt and set aside.

step 2
To make the dressing, mix the lime juice, sugar, fish sauce and garlic and set aside. In a large bowl, pour boiling water over the noodles. Leave them for 2 minutes or until they are just cooked, then rinse them with cold water. Drain well, shake the strainer several times to remove excess water, and return to the bowl. Add the prawns, onion, chilli, cucumber and herbs. Pour the dressing, toss, then sprinkle with the shallots and peanuts.

db:53245.s:
step 1
Place the noodles in a large bowl and then pour over enough boiling water to cover them. Pour in the sliced ​​​​sugar candies and leave for 4 minutes. Drain in a colander, run under cold running water to cool, then drain again. Pour into a bowl and add sesame oil.

step 2
Mix the dressing ingredients. Pile scallions, cilantro, and salmon on top of the noodles, pour over the dressing, and toss everything together. Serve with a pretzel or bagel.

db:53246.s:
step 1
Pour the carrots, cabbage and onion into a bowl. Prepare the dressing by stirring the ingredients until the sugar has dissolved. Pour over the salad and add the vegetables to the dressing. Add the herbs, stir again, then scatter over the peanuts.

db:53247.t: Sea bass with sizzled ginger, chilli & spring onions
i: 3 cloves of garlic cut into thin slices
db:53247.s:
step 1
Season 6 sea bass fillets with salt and pepper then cut the skin 3 times.

step 2
Heat a heavy-based frying pan and add 1 tablespoon of sunflower oil.

step 3
Once hot, fry the sea bass fillets, skin side down, for 5 minutes or until the skin is very crispy and golden. The fish will be almost cooked.

step 4
Flip, cook for another 30 seconds - 1 minute, then transfer to a serving plate and keep warm. You will have to fry the sea bass fillets in 2 batches.

step 5
Heat 2 tablespoons of sunflower oil, then fry the large piece of peeled ginger, cut into sticks, 3 cloves of thinly sliced garlic and 3 finely grated red chillies for about 2 minutes until golden brown.

step 6
Remove from heat and add the bunch of grated chives. Splash the fish with 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and pour over the contents of the pan.

db:53248.s:
step 1
Heat the oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Place the noodles in a bowl and pour in enough boiling water to cover them. Leave for 2 minutes, until pliable but not too soft, then drain well. Return to the bowl with the chives, petit pois, salt and pepper and a third of the butter. Mix well until the butter melts.

step 2
Stack the noodles and vegetables on two large squares of baking paper, then place the salmon on top. Cut the remaining butter into slices and place it over the top of the salmon. Place the ends of the paper over the fish, fold to seal, and then tuck the ends of the paper underneath so there are no gaps. Place the packets on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes. Transfer to plates and serve without delay.

db:53249.s:
step 1
To make the pickled slaw, pour the carrots and cabbage into a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine the ginger, rice vinegar, sugar, and a few pinches of salt. Pour over the vegetables and mix. Set aside for at least 15 minutes.

step 2
Cut the baguettes in half lengthwise and spread the pâté over the bottom half. Top with the pickled slaw, cucumber and turkey. Mix the mayonnaise with the chopped chili and spread on top. Sprinkle over the mint leaves and sliced ​​chilli. Make a sandwich and enjoy.

db:53250.s:
step 1
Put the grated vegetables in a bowl and add the vinegar, sugar and 1 teaspoon of salt. Mix everything together and then set aside to quickly pickle while you prepare the rest of the sandwich.

step 2
Heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Cut the baguette into quarters, then cut each piece horizontally in half. Place the baguette pieces in the oven for 5 minutes until lightly toasted and warmed through. Spread each piece with a layer of hummus, then top four pieces with the tempeh slices and pile the pickled vegetables on top. To serve, sprinkle the herbs and squeeze on some hot sauce, then top with the other baguette pieces to make sandwiches.

db:53251.s:
step 1
Sift the flour into a large bowl, make a well in the middle and sprinkle the yeast. Pour 125ml of water over the yeast and then dredge flour over the liquid to create a layer. Cover and let sit in a warm place for 15 minutes until cracks appear on the surface of that layer.

step 2
Use your hands to mix a further 250ml of water along with 1 teaspoon of salt and knead the dough for about 10 minutes until it is elastic and no longer sticky. Add a little more flour if necessary. Cover and let it rest again in a warm place for 30 minutes until doubled in size.

step 3
Heat the oven to the highest possible setting (approximately 240°C/220°C fan/gas 9) and sprinkle one or two baking trays with cornflour.

step 4
Pour boiling water from the kettle over the tomatoes, let them sit briefly, then drain and remove the skin. Cut the tomatoes in half, cut off the stems, remove the seeds and discard, then chop the pulp.

step 5
Cut the chillies in half lengthwise, remove the stems, seeds and white inner membrane, then rinse. Cut lengthwise into thin strips and then widthwise into fine dice.

step 6
Put the tomatoes, chillies, chives, finely chopped parsley, minced meat, spices, 1 teaspoon salt and ½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper in a bowl and mix well.

step 7
Take the dough and knead it briefly, then divide it into four pieces and shape each one into a ball. Roll each ball into a thin circle and place on the prepared baking sheets. Spread with a thin layer of the meat mixture.

step 8
Bake each flatbread for 10 to 15 minutes until the edges begin to darken. After removing it from the oven, sprinkle the lahmacun with the chopped parsley and sliced ​​onion, then squeeze in a few drops of lemon juice. Serve immediately.

db:53252.s:
step 1
Pour the rice into a very large bowl of cold running water and carefully drain the water from the bowl through a strainer. Repeat several times until the water in the bowl is clear, then fill it with cold water and let the rice soak for 10 minutes while you cook the noodles.

step 2
Put the oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Add the noodles and stir continuously until the strands turn a deep golden color, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in butter until melted and let noodles cool for 1-2 minutes.

step 3
Drain the rice well through a sieve. Add the rice to the pan and stir well. Pour the hot broth into the pan, sprinkle with ½ teaspoon salt, stir well, and then return the pan to the hob over high heat. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat as low as possible, cover the pan and simmer for 7-9 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat, cover it with a couple of sheets of kitchen paper or a light kitchen towel and the pan lid, and let the rice sit in the pan for 10 minutes. Stir with a fork before serving.

db:53253.t: Imam bayildi with BBQ lamb & tzatziki
db:53253.s:
step 1
Heat the oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Cut the aubergines in half lengthwise and deeply score the flesh side, brush with a good layer of olive oil and place on a baking tray. Roast for 20 minutes or until the flesh is soft enough to remove.

step 2
Sauté the onion in a little oil until soft, add the garlic and cinnamon and sauté for 1 min. Once the eggplants are cool enough to handle, core them. Coarsely chop the pulp and add it to the onions. Cut the tomatoes in half, collect the seeds and juice in a strainer set over a bowl, then chop the pulp. Add the chopped tomatoes to the pan and cook for 10 minutes until tender and soft. Add a little more oil if necessary. Add the parsley, leaving a little to scatter at the end.

step 3
Place the eggplant halves in a baking dish and divide the tomato mixture between them. Pour over the tomato juice, drizzle with more olive oil and bake for 30 minutes until the eggplants collapse.

step 4
Meanwhile, mix the tzatziki ingredients and place in a small serving bowl.

step 5
Season the lamb with salt, black pepper and a pinch of paprika. Grill, broil or broil for 3 minutes each side or until the fat is nicely browned, then place on a serving platter and squeeze over the lemon halves. Sprinkle the eggplant with parsley and serve with the lamb and tzatziki.

db:53254.s:
step 1
Put the tomatoes and all the peppers in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Pass through a sieve, place over a bowl and let strain. Add the onions, garlic and parsley to the food processor and blend until finely chopped, then set aside.

step 2
Add the red pepper paste, tomato puree, pomegranate molasses, pul biber, sumac, dried mint and most of the extra virgin olive oil to a serving bowl and whisk well so everything combines like a sauce. Add the chopped onion mixture and strained pepper mixture along with 1 teaspoon flaked sea salt. Stir well and then drizzle with the rest of the extra virgin olive oil to serve.

db:53255.t: Grilled aubergines with spicy chickpeas & walnut sauce
db:53255.s:
step 1
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan, add the onion and fry until soft and lightly golden, about 10 minutes. Add the chilli, ginger and spices and mix well. Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and 5 tablespoons of water, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Add a little salt, pepper and lemon juice.

step 2
Place the eggplants on a grill pan. Brush lightly with oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper, then grill until golden brown. Turn them over, brush with oil again, season and roast again until tender and golden.

step 3
Mix the yogurt with the garlic, most of the walnuts and coriander and a little salt and pepper. Place the eggplant slices on a warm platter and pour over the chickpea mixture. Drizzle with walnut sauce and sprinkle with remaining walnuts and cilantro.

db:53256.s:
step 1
Place a sieve over a large bowl, line it with a thick sheet of undyed kitchen paper or a clean muslin cloth, and pour in the yogurt. Cover with another sheet of kitchen paper and leave to strain in the refrigerator for a minimum of 12 hours.

step 2
Add the lemon juice, most of the olive oil and dried mint to a bowl and stir well so the dried mint softens and absorbs the juices. Add the strained yogurt, then pour in the strained yogurt liquid and set the container aside.

step 3
Cut the cucumbers in half lengthwise and remove the seeds by running a teaspoon from the top to the bottom of the flesh, cut the cucumbers in half widthwise to make them shorter and easier to handle, then coarsely grate each one into the bowl you were straining the yogurt into. Using clean hands (or a clean muslin cloth), squeeze as much liquid as possible from the cucumber.

step 4
Add the strained grated cucumber, garlic and ¾ teaspoon flake salt to the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Garnish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a pinch of dried mint.

db:53257.s:
step 1
Pour the ground beef into a large bowl (use a clean dishwashing container if you don't have anything large enough) with all the other burger ingredients and a good pinch of salt. Roll up your sleeves, put your hands in the mixture and mash everything with your fingers until completely mixed. Form 16 small patties with the mixture. They can now be frozen for up to 1 month or chilled up to a day in advance.

step 2
To cook, heat the grill to its highest temperature and place the burgers in a single layer on a baking sheet (you may need to do this in batches, depending on the size of the sheet). Grill on the highest rack for 5 to 6 minutes per side until browned and cooked through. Stack the burgers on a plate and serve with all the fixings, so everyone can make their own sandwich.

db:53258.t: Hot cumin lamb wrap with crunchy slaw & spicy mayo
db:53258.s:
step 1
Heat an iron. Rub the lamb fillets with oil, cumin and a little seasoning. Grill for about 3-4 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Set aside on a plate to rest.

step 2
In a large bowl, add sugar to vinegar until dissolved. Add the carrots, scallions, cabbage and a little seasoning, and mix.

step 3
Blend whole peppers and mayonnaise in a food processor. Add plenty of salad to each flatbread. Cut the lamb into slices, remove excess fat and place on top of the salad, sprinkling with the remaining juice. Pour over the mayonnaise and sprinkle with some of the sliced ​​peppers. Roll up and eat. If you use pitta, divide it and so on. Serve any extra salad on the side.

db:53259.s:
step 1
Heat grill to very hot. Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and then roast for 25 minutes, turning occasionally, until soft; The skin will remain firm, but the flesh will soften. Lift the eggplants from the grill and let them cool enough to handle.

step 2
Using a sharp knife, cut into the roast and scoop it out with a spoon. Pour into a bowl and mash with a fork until you get a thick pulp. Add the lemon juice and garlic. Add the yogurt and dill and season. Serve while still hot.

db:53260.t: Slow-roast lamb with cinnamon, fennel & citrus
db:53260.s:
step 1
Place the lamb in a large food bag with all the juices and marinate overnight.

step 2
The next day, take the lamb out of the refrigerator 1 hour before you want to cook it. Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Remove the lamb from the marinade (reserve the rest of the marinade) and pat dry. Rub with half the oil and roast for 15-20 minutes until golden brown. Remove the lamb and reduce the oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3.

step 3
Mix zest, remaining oil, honey, spices and garlic with plenty of seasoning. Place a large sheet of baking paper on top of a large sheet of aluminum foil. Place the leg of lamb on top, rub it all over with the paste and lift up the sides of the foil. Drizzle the marinade on the base and tighten the foil to seal.

step 4
Roast for 4 hours, until very tender. Rest, still wrapped, for 30 minutes. Unwrap and serve with juices.

db:53261.t: Chicken wings with cumin, lemon & garlic
db:53261.s:
step 1
Using a sharp pair of kitchen shears, cut each wing at knuckle height into two pieces. Toss the garlic, lemon zest and juice, cumin and oil with plenty of seasoning, then pour onto a plate with the chicken wings and toss to coat. Cover and put in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 1 hour, or overnight if you have time.

step 2
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6, or heat an outdoor barbecue. Bake chicken wings on a baking sheet for 45 to 50 minutes until crispy, or grill for 20 minutes, basting with honey during the last 10 minutes of each method. Serve on a plate with plenty of paper napkins. Fill small bowls with olives, pistachios or almonds, dates, pickled chiles, and flatbreads to accompany, along with the dishes below.

db:53262.s:
step 1
Finely chop the peppers in a food processor, then place them in a strainer and press them against the strainer so that the peppers release all their juice. Pour into a bowl along with the minced meat, red pepper paste, pul biber, 1½ teaspoons of flaked sea salt and 2 tablespoons of oil. Mix, kneading well for at least 2-3 minutes. If necessary, wet your hands with cold water to prevent the mixture from sticking. The mixture should be sticky when ready. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours or up to 12 hours.

step 2
When you are ready to cook, heat the grill to high or the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 6. Divide the mixture into 12 equal portions, approximately 85g each. If you want to skewer them, divide them into 8 equal portions and shape them into balls. With wet hands, thread the balls onto the end of the skewers, massaging the mixture between your palms, until evenly distributed. Make sure the mixture is completely wrapped around the skewers without any exposed metal. Alternatively, place them on a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper if cooking them in the oven, or aluminum foil if cooking them under the broiler. Form a köfte 20 cm long. Wet your fingers with a little cold water and make slits along the köfte to give it the traditional shape.

step 3
Gently brush each köfte with the remaining tablespoon of oil and cook under the broiler on the top rack for 10 to 12 minutes, turning regularly, or cook in the oven for 16 to 18 minutes, until crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside.

db:53263.s:
step 1
Fry the pine nuts or almonds in a large frying pan until lightly toasted, then pour them onto a plate. Add the oil to the pan, then sauté the onion and cinnamon together until they begin to brown. Increase the heat, add the lamb, fry until the meat changes color, then pour in the rice and cook for 1 min, stirring all the time.

step 2
Pour in 500ml boiling water, crumble into the stock cube, add the apricots, then season to taste. Lower the heat, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the rice is tender and the broth has been absorbed. Add the pine nuts and mint and serve.

db:53264.s:
step 1
You need 15 skewers: if they are wooden, soak them in water for 10 minutes. Cut the chicken into 3cm pieces and place in a bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil, the spices, garlic and vinegar, stir well and season. You can make this up to a day ahead and refrigerate.

step 2
Thread 2-3 pieces onto each skewer. Pour the remaining oil into a frying pan or rub it on a griddle. Heat the skillet and sear the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes on each side; You may need to do this in batches, keeping the cooked skewers warm in the low oven. Serve with smoked aioli if desired.

db:53265.s:
step 1
Put the garlic in a bowl with the ginger, lemon juice, oil, spices and seasoning. Blend with a hand mixer until smooth, then use to coat the lamb chops on both sides. Marinate in the refrigerator for a couple of hours or overnight.

step 2
Heat a barbecue until hot. Grill the chops over the coals for 3 minutes on each side until cooked through but still pink and juicy in the center.

db:53266.s:
step 1
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large frying pan, then fry the onion and garlic over low heat for 5 minutes until softened. Pour into a large bowl with the chickpeas and spices, then mash with a fork or potato masher until the chickpeas are completely disintegrated. Add the parsley or dried herbs and season to taste.
